prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1075; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a parking lot collision involving your insured. Effective immediately, please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the complete policy limits of liability coverage applicable to your insured, including any excess or umbrella coverage, along with a copy of the declarations page. Please also confirm in writing whether a claim has been opened and identify the assigned adjuster.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes, without limitation, photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle data and event recorder information, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file notes, and any repair or appraisal records. Any loss or destruction of such material may expose your insured and your company to sanctions.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and respond within fourteen days. We look forward to your prompt cooperation.
